changelog: Full check logic mirrored from apworld v1.0.0 - checks now show green only when that category's unlocks are held: machines (incl. 'bust X riding Y' pairs), abilities, events, patches, boxes, City Trial items, Top Ride items, Air Ride/Top Ride courses, stadiums, legendary completion, item-pickup counts, and prerequisite chains
'Fill in over 100 Checklist blocks' stays out of logic until 99 boxes are filled (per mode; Stadium counts toward City Trial)
Seed Settings indicators renamed to progression_* and now drive the check logic
Added Stadium Prediction event and Invincible Candy Top Ride item
Top Ride control machines auto-light on connect and grey out when disconnected
Broadcast view now shows all item panels
Added Compact layout and reworked item layout for small screens
Resized icons to 32px (City Trial Events at 48px in a 3x5 grid)
Added Attack Up, Candy, Defense Up, No Charge, Run Amok, Speed Up to Special Offense
New event icons: Dyna Blade, Tac, Rails on Fire, Dense Fog, Air Ride Formation, Box Bounce, Same Items, Lighthouse
Secret Chamber and Lighthouse now show open/closed (lit/unlit) states
Added sparkles to the Restoration Area icon
